notes.title: RELEASE: Lisa the temptress and Tracy's infidelity expansion
notes.notes: [p]We’re back with a searing two-part expansion that cranks up the tension in LWT: American Sunset. This isn’t just a continuation—it’s a descent into dangerous passions, forbidden choices, and moments that will test every boundary. Seduction collides with betrayal, and voyeuristic thrills spiral into something far more perilous. Get ready: every decision cuts deeper, and every encounter risks everything.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Lisa Unleashed[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The first chapter wastes no time turning up the heat. Lisa, no longer hiding behind innocence, unleashes her full seductive power. After a chaotic night of partying, Justin finds himself in her orbit—and she’s in no mood to play coy. What follows is a whirlwind of temptation and recklessness: sneaking under the sheets while Tracy lies asleep, ambushing Justin at work with a provocative toy-fueled fantasy, and even dragging him into a brazen sugar daddy roleplay. Lisa becomes unstoppable—a force of raw desire, dangerous and intoxicating in equal measure. This is Lisa unchained.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/348d03ea56fd6bfba3c48fc02d7678dbaf8c70b3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/1d0776d1864f6beedbd047e8efb3c91a6eef3a48.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/3c4c0806533bbeea536dcd03ac59b5823311bb6d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/680d847f20c437205caf1350449f902d64758121.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Tracy’s Turn[/b][/h3][p align="start"]But every flame leaves a burn. Tracy begins to sense the truth, and once the affair is uncovered, her response is anything but passive. Fueled by fury and desire, she sets out on her own path of infidelity. It begins with a shocking nightclub bathroom tryst with Daniel, but it doesn’t stop there. Hotel rooms, office encounters—each meeting grows more intense, more deliberate, transforming Justin into a helpless voyeur of his own downfall. And in the devastating finale, he’s left stranded outside a hotel door, forced to listen as Tracy and Daniel cross one final, forbidden line… while a bored maid looks on, indifferent to his unraveling.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/a0bb537d03269859f3b9a12114075edd315bce1e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/0cf9c59c79ce2d3176c3847fff6a844a5eb62de7.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/d73a5d40f4f719cc41e9e40e5ae4d089c6d7b502.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/6be23654e88bbc0b27113e62068e9459a615b632.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Expansion at a Glance[/b][/h3][p align="start"]This update doesn’t just add scenes—it deepens the story. It injects American Sunset with raw drama, moral choices, and unflinching erotic tension. It’s unapologetic, unpredictable, and unforgettable.[/p][p align="start"]The heat is rising—and it’s here.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2834110/Living_with_temptation_American_sunset/?curator_clanid=35434564"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]MORE INFO[/p][p][url="https://blog.lessonofpassion.com" style="button"]Visit our blog to find out more about this release[/url][/p]

notes.notes: [p][b]LWT: American Sunset[/b] will return with a scorching two-part expansion that takes seduction, betrayal, and voyeuristic tension to new and dangerous heights. Get ready for a bold continuation where every choice cuts deeper—and every encounter pushes the limits.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Lisa Unleashed[/b][/h3][p]In the first part of the expansion, Lisa sheds any pretense of innocence and fully embraces her seductive power. After a chaotic night of partying, a drunken Lisa is picked up by Justin—and she’s in no mood to play coy. She teases and tempts him relentlessly, spiraling into a series of daring encounters that blur every line of decency. From slipping into bed while Tracy sleeps unaware, to ambushing Justin in his office with a provocative fleshlight fantasy, Lisa becomes a force of pure temptation. And when a bold sugar daddy roleplay enters the mix, it’s clear—this is Lisa at her most fearless, most dangerous, and most addictive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/06a41d1b2acc22e858e3dccb4e49625316884fce.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/019fe5ef9dce36d7f696be535dd4916a40e07fc7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/594efaffa6fd9cac720f88473a7930b33754df40.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/d0543e677641e584ca2f9e29b0808e0d3a4eb77e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/df5d0c6bbe20c3a7f01541aef8b55734d31e337b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/e6618e7190bc0ec2f5bc395da0b3ec9f4611ec08.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Tracy’s Turn[/b][/h3][p]But lust leaves scars—and Tracy isn’t blind to what’s happening. notes.title: UPDATE RELEASE: 4K + Dominique & Coco
notes.notes: [h2]Today, we're releasing a FREE expansion with new Dominique and Coco content. Furthermore, everything we've done so far has been upscaled to 4K resolution.[/h2][p][/p][h3]MORE ABOUT THE EXPANSION[/h3][p]Justin’s provocative publisher, Dominique, takes the spotlight in this new content arc. What starts as a slow burn — full of subtle tension and romantic charm — quickly turns into a wild emotional rollercoaster. As Dominique lets go of control, she dives deep into a mix of female domination, revenge, and emotional fallout. Expect scenes that are raw, hot, and deeply psychological, pushing boundaries in all the right ways.[/p][p][/p][p]In contrast, we’re crafting a tender, introspective storyline with Coco, who slowly begins to reconnect with her bisexual side after a long emotional drought. Every inch of our models’ bodies will be more vivid, more lifelike, and more immersive than ever before.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2834110/Living_with_temptation_American_sunset/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/5e581f34ed3baf19832caa7e0738e07e6d1904e6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/0377b1cb9beb0b570bab70f0858f59784fb0a8aa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/e84d0be83ac9e0b68354e363ba835185d801c2cf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/bc19c29cb7d51494483b802b8afad2ad15e898f2.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]DO YOU WANT TO FIND OUT MORE ABOUT THE SEQUEL?[/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444540/Living_with_Temptation_2_French_Confessions/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://blog.lessonofpassion.com" style="button"]Visit our blog for more info![/url][/p]

notes.title: DOMINIQUE & COCO update
notes.notes:
[b]Hey, thrill-seekers and sensual adventurers![/b]

We’re excited to announce that we’re deep in development on a brand-new expansion for LWT: American Sunset — and things are about to get intense.

[h2]Dominique’s Story: Power, Passion, and Consequences[/h2]
Justin’s provocative publisher Dominique takes the spotlight in this new content arc. What starts as a slow burn — full of subtle tension and romantic charm — quickly turns into a wild emotional rollercoaster.
As Dominique lets go of control, she dives deep into a mix of female domination, revenge, and emotional fallout. Expect scenes that are raw, hot, and deeply psychological, pushing boundaries in all the right ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/df2dcf35d9d91f7dc60da4637c34995963bb838f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/f2f7245138e720699fc20ed84b43ddfc98b7637e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Coco’s Journey: Healing, Sensuality, and Self-Discovery[/h2]
In contrast, we’re crafting a tender, introspective storyline with Coco, who slowly begins to reconnect with her bisexual side after a long emotional drought.
Experience warm, sensual moments with Coco and your wife, as she rediscovers intimacy, explores her desires, and possibly opens herself to something more… including Justin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/94c00e215e177097951729aacd3d55501f6ec911.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/bc80f2b0ee0a7a92ad11ea2523efc97eed0d4f15.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/ed1e23bd9594f1e6311c2ca4ebc7ed11db28aaf5.jpg[/img]

[h2]And here’s the BIG bonus: We’re going FULL 4K![/h2]
That’s right — LWT: American Sunset is being upgraded to 4K resolution!
Every static scene, every sensual animation, and every emotional glance will be sharper, deeper, and more immersive than ever before.

What this means for you:

- Super crisp details in every erotic and cinematic moment
- Characters and environments that pop with life and color

[b]Whether you’re into dominance, romance, healing, or exploration, this update has something for everyone — and we can’t wait to share it with you.
[/b]

[h2]Stay tuned for a summer release window and get ready to experience American Sunset like never before - now in glorious 4K.[/h2]

notes.title: LWT: American sunset available now!
notes.notes:
[h1]STEAM! HERE WE GO![/h1]
Yes! The latest edition of TRACY and LISA adventures finally arrived on STEAM! 

LIVING WITH TEMPTATION is a sensual relationship simulator in which you need to balance your love for Tracy, your wife and your desire for your nanny, Lisa. The game was initially released in 2013, and then in 2021, we prepared a remodeled version with new renders and more content. Now, over 10 years after the original release, we’re presenting to you its evolution, AMERICAN SUNSET.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/26336e0bd6805c8e232e0fddb319ddfa2342a0f7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/4dd89f54ac17ed4414809c19301dc9aa52ff302c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882845/bd938e797f382f542a2c202506c10035c690bafe.jpg[/img]

This new project utilizes already-created assets mixed with a crazy amount of new content produced exclusively for this game version. Everything is produced in a new game engine with heavenly improved mechanics, minimizing grind, getting rid of all limitations, and making all interactions as enjoyable as possible.

So, help Tracy with the household chores, take care of your baby, earn money and spoil her with your kindness. Rediscover the pleasure of sex with your wife again, or… fall in love with your nanny… or any other girl you meet in our version of Los Angeles. Temptation awaits.

[b]STEAM version already includes UPDATE 1: CALEB BASEMENT RENOVATION + OFFICE ROMANCE[/b]

notes.title: Work in progress
notes.notes:
The development of American Sunset goes well. We may separate it into two parts:

[b]Updating old content,[/b] already produced for LWT and all previous expansions, and putting it into the new game script. All images must be touched with a new post-processing, all animations reworked into a new format, and everything together is pasted into a new game script. We have all BASE, WILD WEEKENDS, and WIFE GONE WILDER content already transformed. Still, we’re missing the SWINGER’S CLUB scene because we plan to significantly upgrade it, and the whole LUSCIOUS SECRET expansion is missing (plans for upgrades as well)

[b] Creating new content [/b], including new locations, characters, and scenes. In that area, we’re focusing on expanding daily interactions with girls and introducing new characters. With time, we’ll start adding new potlines.
